outcome: postpartum insulin resistance markers (HOMA-IR, QUICKI, HbA1c)
glucose screening test results during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 70 participants: mothers with gestational diabetes (treated with diet/physical activity or insulin) and a control group of healthy mothers without gestational diabetes.
finding: The degree of glucose metabolism disorders, hypothyroidism, and gestational weight gain influence maternal insulin resistance markers in the first week postpartum, with gestational weight fluctuation also impacting fetal growth and infant birth weight/adipose tissue accumulation.
birth_weight: Infant birth weight was mentioned as an outcome influenced by gestational weight fluctuation.
